tables.labor_schema_receipts: CREATE TABLE `labor_schema_receipts` (`id` int NOT NULL,`version` varchar(32) NOT NULL,`plan_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_receipt_one` CHECK (`id`=1)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.labor_openings: CREATE TABLE `labor_openings` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`employee_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`employee_snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`date` date NOT NULL,`amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `labor_one_opening` (`employee_id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_open_employee_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_open_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_open_amount` CHECK (`amount`>=0),CONSTRAINT `labor_open_snapshot` CHECK (json_valid(`employee_snapshot`))) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.labor_earnings: CREATE TABLE `labor_earnings` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`line_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`employee_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`employee_snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`item_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`item_snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`date` date NOT NULL,`quantity` varchar(32) NOT NULL,`labor_rate` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,`amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `labor_one_line` (`line_id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_earning_document_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `v1_documents` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_earning_line_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`line_id`) REFERENCES `v1_lines` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_earning_employee_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_earning_item_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`item_id`) REFERENCES `v1_items` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_earning_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_exact_earning` CHECK (`quantity` REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND `labor_rate`>=0 AND `amount`>=0 AND `amount`=CAST(`quantity` AS DECIMAL(20,0))*`labor_rate`),CONSTRAINT `labor_earning_snapshots` CHECK (json_valid(`employee_snapshot`) AND json_valid(`item_snapshot`))) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.labor_payments: CREATE TABLE `labor_payments` (`id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`employee_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`employee_snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`date` date NOT NULL,`amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,`money_account_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`money_batch_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`method` enum('CASH','BANK_TRANSFER') NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`reference_key` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `labor_one_money_batch` (`money_batch_id`),UNIQUE KEY `labor_payment_reference` (`employee_id`,`reference_key`),CONSTRAINT `labor_payment_employee_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_payment_account_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`money_account_id`) REFERENCES `money_accounts` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_payment_batch_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`money_batch_id`) REFERENCES `money_batches` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_payment_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_payment_positive` CHECK (`amount`>0),CONSTRAINT `labor_payment_snapshot` CHECK (json_valid(`employee_snapshot`))) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.labor_audit: CREATE TABLE `labor_audit` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`entry_type` enum('OPENING','EARNING','PAYMENT') NOT NULL,`entry_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`employee_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`payload_hash` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `labor_one_audit` (`entry_type`,`entry_id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_audit_employee_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `labor_audit_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
